status: Post hoc sensitivity calibration, exploratory, not preregistered; it changes no preregistered decision. Written before any spike-in run.

criteria.status: Post hoc sensitivity calibration, exploratory, not preregistered; it changes no preregistered decision. Written before any spike-in run.
criteria.written: 2026-10-16, before any spike-in code was run
criteria.question: What is the smallest amount of real pair knowledge, in kappa units against the DrugBank lookup ceiling, that the H1 pipeline detects on the frozen rows?
criteria.kappa_definition: kappa = (A_within(s) - 0.5) / (A_within(DrugBank) - 0.5), both within-drug AUROC (stats.stratified_auroc) on the same rows; A_within(DrugBank) is the real DrugBank lookup (scripts/amend7_cpu_common.drugbank_score) with ties counted one half

cohorts.primary: older_clean tier A (1832 rows, 128 drugs), bootstrap seed 42
secondary: novel tier A (438 rows, 48 drugs), bootstrap seed 1042

older_clean tier B and novel tier B: the same synthetic scores (built on tier A) restricted to rows with dbstate == 1; the x axis stays the tier A target kappa and the tier B DrugBank ceiling is recomputed on the tier B rows

bases.primary: b2mixed: the real b2mixed-biomedbert P(interaction) averaged over seeds 42, 1, 2, 3, 4 (ood_empty for Novel, oodold_empty for Older), restricted to the cohort rows
bases.secondary: noise: an independent standard normal draw per row and per rep, in place of b2mixed

blend.formula: s = w * r_db + (1 - w) * (r_base + sigma * z)
blend.r_db: normalised rank (rank / n) over the cohort tier A rows of the DrugBank lookup score with a uniform random tie-break drawn per rep
blend.r_base: normalised rank (rank / n, average ranks for ties) of the base score over the same rows; for the noise base a fresh normal draw per rep
blend.z: standard normal jitter per row and per rep
blend.calibration: w grid 0 to 1 in steps of 0.01; for each w, 100 calibration draws (random streams disjoint from the reps) give the mean realised point-estimate kappa on the full cohort rows; the curve is made monotone by a running maximum and w for each target is found by linear interpolation; a target below the curve at w = 0 or above it at w = 1 is flagged unreachable and not run. Calibration is done separately per cohort and per base.
blend.rep_seed: numpy default_rng([base_id, cohort_id, grid_index, rep, 0]) for reps; [base_id, cohort_id, 999, w_index, draw, 1] for calibration

bootstrap.method: two-way cluster bootstrap over OOD drugs and partner drugs with the same RandomState call sequence as stats.two_way_samples and evaluate2.within_stat (seed 42 for Older, 1042 for Novel), each resampled drug copy a separate stratum (Amendment 6.6); the same draw indices are used for every rep, as the pipeline would use them for any model. Implemented as a batched within-drug AUROC that is tested to equal stats.two_way_samples(stats.stratified_auroc, ..., strat=g).
bootstrap.secondary: one-way drug bootstrap with the same seed, drugs resampled with replacement, partners fixed, each drug copy a separate stratum

decisions.auroc_rule_primary: H1 rule of Amendments 4 and 6: equivalent if the 90% percentile interval (5th, 95th) lies strictly inside (0.40, 0.60); falsified if the 95% lower bound (2.5th percentile) is above 0.60; otherwise inconclusive. Applied to Novel as well for calibration, although the preregistration reports Novel as an estimate only.
decisions.auroc_rule_holm: evaluate2.decide_equivalence with the Holm adjustment of evaluate2.holm over H1 (this rep's p_tost), H4 (observed 0.3387) and H6 (observed 0.1019), as in decisions.json; secondary
decisions.p_tost: evaluate2.tost_p on the two-way draws, reported per rep
decisions.kappa_rule: alternative margin in kappa units with paired draws (the same bootstrap draw for the synthetic score and the real DrugBank lookup): equivalent if the 97.5th percentile of the kappa draws is at most 0.25; falsified if the 2.5th percentile is above 0.25; otherwise inconclusive
decisions.detection: signal detected if the 95% lower bound of the within-drug AUROC is above 0.50 (two-way bootstrap)

reported_curves: P(falsified), P(equivalent), P(inconclusive) against target kappa, AUROC rule, two-way bootstrap, per cohort, base and tier
the same with the Holm rule and with the one-way drug bootstrap
P(falsified), P(equivalent), P(inconclusive) under the kappa rule
mean and sd of the realised point-estimate kappa and AUROC per grid point, mean 90% and 95% bounds

summaries.b: smallest grid kappa with P(falsified) >= 0.80, and the linearly interpolated crossing; 'not reached' if no grid point reaches it
summaries.c: largest grid kappa with P(equivalent) >= 0.20, and the linearly interpolated crossing
summaries.d: b and c under the kappa rule
summaries.e: the observed b2mixed Older-clean result (kappa point -0.342, 95% upper 0.133, decision inconclusive) placed on the curves: decision probabilities at kappa 0.133 by linear interpolation and the grid points it excludes

middle_cohort_simulation.design: pooled cohort = the 128 Older-clean drugs plus 60 drugs drawn with replacement from the Older-clean drugs, each copied with all its rows (labels, partners, DrugBank score, b2mixed score) under a new drug id; 188 drugs
middle_cohort_simulation.material_change: b or c moves by at least one grid step (0.05 below 0.2, 0.1 above) in interpolated terms on the AUROC rule or the kappa rule

tests: kappa 0 recovers a within-drug AUROC of about 0.5 (noise base)
kappa 1 recovers the DrugBank within-drug AUROC
the pipeline on the real b2mixed scores reproduces the evaluate2 H1 decision, estimate and intervals
